title: Stop workspace autosave retries on permanent HTTP failures
outcome: Post-fix dual review, parent-verified at HEAD 4dec5eb with frozen source 0cf0e542. ui/src/app-workspace-layout.ts:465 catches every rejected latest save and reschedules indefinitely with a 30-second cap. api-request.ts exposes ApiRequestError.status and rejects all non-ok HTTP responses. A permanent 400/413 therefore keeps resending the unchanged layout while the tab remains mounted. Distinct from tm-e7tp, which observed write-blocked fresh-browser requests rather than permanent HTTP response handling. Classify failures: retry transient network/offline, 5xx, 408/429 appropriately; stop automatic retry for permanent 4xx, preserve unsaved content and surface the failure. Add regression coverage distinguishing permanent failures, transient recovery, and superseding edits. Source-chain confirmation, not a live-server reproduction. No implementation performed in this review.
